name: sound_index
description: The sound of each kural by rule: letter weights per line, asai and seer patterns, monai (initial alliteration), edukai (second-letter rhyme between lines) and end rhyme.

fields.name: letters_per_line
fields.description: Per line: short-vowel letters (kuril), long-vowel letters (nedil) and pulli consonants (ottu).

fields.name: asai_pattern
fields.description: Asai of every seer: NE for ner, NI for nirai, seer separated by |.

fields.name: venba_ok
fields.description: Checker v0.1 (tkcore.prosody.check): whether the word-split text scans as kural venba with each printed word read as a foot. derived.scansion_ok has the v0.3 verdict.

fields.name: monai
fields.description: Per line: which seer alliterate with the first, and the named monai pattern where one fits.

fields.name: edukai
fields.description: Whether the second letters of the two lines rhyme (edukai).

fields.name: end_rhyme
fields.description: Whether the two lines end on the same letter.

fields.name: agreement_with_chandrasekar_seers
fields.description: Share of seer names that agree with the Chandrasekar yaappu analysis; null where it has none.
